name: Omnea
summary: A procurement platform (intake, approvals, sourcing, contracts, supplier management and third-party risk) whose vendor announces a hosted MCP server at mcp.omnea.co for customers and a REST API whose documentation sits behind a login. Measured keyless: the MCP host answers initialize with 401 and an RFC 9728 Bearer challenge; its OAuth metadata names an external authorization server with dynamic client registration and PKCE S256.

payments.notes: 2026-11-10: www.omnea.co/pricing answers 404 and no page read states a price, a free tier or billing terms; the site's Terms of Use govern the website only. The MCP launch page says the server is available for all customers. No surface prices an MCP call in money.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-11-10 06:10Z, no credentials: POST initialize to mcp.omnea.co and /mcp both 401 with a Bearer resource_metadata challenge; protected-resource and authorization-server metadata public (DCR, client ID metadata documents, PKCE S256). REST API docs redirect to a login.

jobs.summary: Vendor's claim: "Continuous Monitoring screens suppliers daily against Dow Jones sanctions, PEPs, and adverse media data", alerts triaged by supplier tier and spend. Its llms.txt adds financial-health changes, which the product pages do not. Not shown to be reachable via MCP. Measured by nobody.
